relationships.subject: Tocovid
relationships.evidence_quote: After 12 months of Tocovid supplementation, all velocity parameters in sural nerves showed statistically significant differences between the Tocovid and placebo groups.

relationships.subject: Tocovid
relationships.evidence_quote: There were no significant differences in HbA1c, blood pressure, serum biomarkers (TGFβ-1 and VEGF-A), or safety tests (eGFR, serum creatinine, and urea) between the Tocovid and placebo groups after 12 months of treatment (Table 5).

key_findings: Tocotrienol-rich vitamin E improved median and sural sensory nerve conduction velocity in T2DM patients over 12 months; benefits diminished after 6 months washout.
No significant change in serum TGF-beta1 or VEGF-A; baseline VEGF-A was negatively associated with sural nerve CV and PV.
